title: Three Years and One Short Lever
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：signal　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 signal 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the engineer ① gave the signal that no worker in the workshop would have counted, and he said the giving was the whole of the year. The ② signal, meaning the sign itself and not the lever, ran three years and stayed uncounted in the book; a signal, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ signal in that workshop had the same short lever beside it, and the ④ signal at the far bench, meaning the part they kept for the children to fit and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A signal, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the engineer said the counting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the signal was the whole of the matter, meaning the meaning and not the sign. The ⑥ signal, meaning the meaning and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; signal, he said, is either something you give or the only word that means both a sign and a meaning. He said the meaning is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ signal had become a line in a manual, and the manual had become an argument about the short lever. The ⑧ signal of the whole thing, the engineer wrote in April, was one workshop and three years of counting; signal, he said, is either the part at the far bench or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ signal I remember is the sign counted in the manual, which closed in 1975 and is still counted as the quietest in the workshop. A ⑩ signal, my mother said in 1977, is the only sign that improves by being counted; every signal, she said, is a meaning that has agreed to look like a sign. She said the meaning was the honest half.

signal 意为“信号”，指最远那张工作台的留给孩子们装的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
signal 意为“信号、意思”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个意思就是那件事的全部。
signal 意为“意思”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个信号，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
signal 意为“信号”，指说明书里写到、被清点的那一个，到 1973 年这一个成了说明书里的一行。
signal 意为“信号之事”，工程师四月写道，整件事的信号之事是一处车间和三个年头的清点。
signal 意为“信号”，我记得的是说明书里清点过的那一个，1975 年装好了，至今仍被说成车间里最安静的一个。
signal 为抽象总称，母亲 1977 年说，信号是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的信号。
